notes.title: QoL Update is Out with More to Come!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/3663b0a74b7cf289141c4ae89ff9b113a9c1f373.png[/img]


Hello, Aspirant Ballionaires (and those already in the 1%),

Before we get to the full list of updates that dropped today, we also wanted to announce our first Content Update, titled the [i]Spring Content Update[/i] (yes yes, we know, we're very creative), coming [b]April 9th[/b]! We are adding [b]one new board[/b] and [b]20 new triggers[/b] for you to play your little hearts out with!

But for now, here's what has been rolled out!

[h2]Bans[/h2]
[list]
[*] There has been an outspoken need to improve control over the board, especially at higher levels when your draft pool is…well… MASSIVE. Well GUESS WHAT? You can now ban unlocked triggers and boons from your profile tab! Use bans to hone your perfect collection of triggers and boons to make number go more up than ever. You asked, we answered.  
[/list]
[h2]Steam Workshop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam Workshop is official launched and ready for you to jump in and get your hands mucky! 
[*] A few “unofficial” mods have gone up from the developer to inspire you on your road to Ballionaire mod-master! Go beyond Tribute 9 in "No Frills Endless Mode" and “Lab Disasters” (Which are some nightmare-inducing Trigger mash-ups) are now available in the Steam Workshop to try!  Don’t like how they’re done? Well, try to make your own and show us up, smartypants! 
[/list]
[h2]QoL:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We’ve finessed spawners to improve performance when HOARDS OF BALLS descend 
[*] To the folks that wanted more control over the starting screen, we’ve added UI Effects option in Display Settings. This controls the amount of animation and flashing on the title screen and game over screen! Screen shake? IN THIS ECONOMY? 
[*] For those of you who are just too good at Ballionaire and have created infinitely lasting drops, you can now end the current drop from the pause menu to avoid becoming a victim of your own success. 
[*] STREAMERS – A new setting has been added to control whether the Falling Money animation plays when the tribute is met to help with BITRATE! 
[/olist]
 

[h2]Full Patch Note List for Update 1.1.0[/h2]

[b]Bans: [/b]
- Added a "Bans" tab to Profiles that allows you to ban individual unlocked triggers and boons, if you don't want to play with them. 
- Added a button on the Unlocks screen to take you directly to the Bans page, for added visibility. 

[b]Performance: [/b]
- Smoothed out performance for massive ball spawns. 

[b]Settings: [/b]
- Rework Settings menu to create separate sections for Sound, Display, Language, Input, and Streaming. 
- Added UI Effects option in Display Settings. This controls the amount of animation and flashing on the title screen and game over screen. 
- Added Seeker Intro option in Display Settings. This controls whether the Seeker Appearing animation plays when you start a run. 
- Added Falling Money option in Display Settings. This controls whether the Falling Money animation plays when the tribute is met. (This was added for streamers because the Falling Money typically destroys a stream's bitrate). 
- Added Screen Shake slider in Display Settings. This controls the amount of screen shake. 
- Added an Input setting to fully disable all controllers (Windows only). This should help w/ folks who have unconventional inputs like a steering wheel that are interfering with mouse control in the game. 

[b]NPE/Onboarding: [/b]
- Increase the number of drops in Initiate mode from 5 to 7. Initiate mode should be a bit easier now. 

[b]Balance: [/b]
- Paper Shredder, Time Capsule, and Computer all trigger Growth Serum now. 
- Harvester is now "Bonked -> Ride the Harvester. While riding Harvester, when this ball bonks a Plant, destroy the Plant and replace it with a Seedling. Then, a random Silo gains $1,600." 

[b]In-game QOL: [/b]
- Added an "End Current Drop" button to the Pause popup, for when a drop might be stuck in an infinite loop. 
- Added 4.0x speedup setting (hotkey: 5). 
- Right-clicking during a draft choice will toggle showing/hiding the draft. 

[b]Custom Runs: [/b]
- Added "Initiate" option (e.g. none) to Tribulation Difficulty in Custom Run setup 
- Added 50% Tribute difficulty multiplier in Custom Run setup 

[b]Sound: [/b]
- LOWERED!!! THE VOLUME!!! OF THE HARVESTER!!! SOUND!!! 

[b]Localization: [/b]
- Korean now uses IM_Hyemin font. 

[b]Mods: [/b]
- Tons of work for mod support. 

[b]Bugs: [/b]
- Significant improvements to Pinball Bumper to prevent balls from passing through it. 
- Fix a really weird interaction that, while "correct", was likely causing a perception of very buggy behavior: as a rule balls can't bonk their own spawners. However, there are some weird cases, like Armored Car or Wallet, where a non-spawner trigger can spawn a ball, e.g. if a ball carrying a Wallet bonks a Pinball Bumper, the Pinball Bumper will spawn a Coin. Per the rule, the Coin would not be capable of bonking the Pinball Bumper, and create the perception that collision detection failed because the Coin would simply pass through the bumper. Now, balls are only prohibited from bonking spawners if it's a true spawner (e.g. a trigger with the Spawner trait), not just a trigger that happens to have a spawn attributed to it. This should generally be more favorable to players, and also greatly reduce the perception that Movers simply "weren't working". 
- Fixed: Gem drafts coming from Rabbit's Foot weren't being attributed to Rabbit's Foot. 
- Fixed: Mouse hover over Game Speed in HUD was not reliably bringing up the tooltip. 
- Fixed: Fixed typo in Ager definition (english)  
- Fixed: A potential Continue Game crash 
- Speculative fix: Forced the (temp) profile file to flush after writing, before renaming/moving to the real profile file. This may help some cases of people losing their save files when the game crashes. (edited)

It doesn’t feel that long ago since we posted about 100k downloads of Ballionaire... probably because it was only last month! 

Well, it’s doubled that now with over 200k downloads! That's like.... if all of Columbus Ohio, Odawara Japan, Burnaby British Columbia, Erfurt Germany, or Yiyang China all got bonkin'. The fact that many people "get" Ballionaire is humbling. And terrifying. Humbfying? Terrumbling? You get it.

notes.title: Testing...
notes.content:
Hey there! 

It’s been a while, but just because we’ve been quiet doesn’t mean things haven’t been happening behind the scenes!

We’ve been paying attention to the features that have been requested from you, the community, since we launched Ballionaire and are testing them on the not-so-secret experimental branch, including features like banning certain triggers.

Members of our wonderful Discord community have been trying and feedbacking on updates and we wanted to invite more of you to get in on the action.

Full details about the branch and the instructions to join it can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2667120/discussions/0/505068838387231735/]here[/url].

We’ll have more details about updates to the full game as soon as we have them, for now we’re still testing to make sure we don’t break the known Ballionaire universe with anything we add in. Testing is important.

Grab a lab coat and some science equipment stuff (if you want to look the part) and join the experimental branch today!

-	The Seeker

notes.title: Trials and Tribulations
notes.content:
Understanding your tiggers, knowing your Spawners from your Holders and having a strategy for your synergy is a really good basis for becoming a Ballionaire… 

But let me tell you a little bit about Tribulations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/c941f2dee03bf4bf99180444a785819fef94791d.jpg[/img]

There are a number of these in Ballionaire that can range from “no big deal” to “why would you do this to me?!” 

Let’s look at a couple.  

A good example is [b]Befuddlement[/b] which means that teleporters have a chance to teleport to a random teleporter not a higher one. Plans? What plans!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/38e66215646e1fe7dd427481d74f7ced4685cd68.jpg[/img]

[b]Abeyance [/b]causes cooldowns to last 50%/100%/200% longer, could ruin a good thing you’ve got going. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/be6970ca2aa092a893eb2382cb653c6e254837e1.jpg[/img]

[b]Diminution[/b] diminishes your triggers in a standard draft when you consecutively reroll, to a minimum of 1! That’s mean!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/d2fc3027afc27887eca50e0e49e962cda752f3c5.jpg[/img]

Tribulations mean you have to switch things up, think on your feet and above all bonk smart! You can find details of all the Tribulations in the Ballpedia in the options menu.

notes.title: We Patched Some Stuff
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback, thank you. 

So let me introduce the first Ballionaire patch:

[h1]v1.0.8 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Trowel was "Whenever a trigger is removed, gain 3 rerolls.". Now, Trowel is: "The first time trigger is removed each turn, gain 3 rerolls." (Fixes infinite loops made possible by Trowel + Swiss Army Knife)
[*]Well is now Unique. (Fixes infinite loops made possible with 3+ Wells and an Abacus)
[/list]
[h3]Slot Machine:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[/list]
[h3]Pinball:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[*]Changes to physics colliders and overlap detection to help with stuck balls as well as Petrification/Conflagration + Dart Trap not interacting well on this board.
[/list]
[h3]Fishing:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[*]The fishing line was completely "stiff" when playing on high-frequency monitors (e.g. 120+ hz). Now the fishing line should be have "normally" (slack and jiggly) regardless of framerate.

notes.title: Spawning Glory
notes.content:
Spawning extra ball types to increase that bank account balance is *chefs kiss* And it’s easier than you might think.  

There are many different Spawners available in Ballionaire that will produce extra ball types to pachinko with, yes I used pachinko as a verb. Extra ball types mean extra bonking opportunities and we’re always in favour of that. 

Brick is the first spawner that comes to mind. You earn $200 from every bonk but if you can position it in such a way that you can bonk it from below, you’ll spawn a coin ball that can embark on it’s journey to synergize with your other eligible triggers. 

Triggers like Campfire and Ice Cubes don’t even need to be initially bonked to spawn. They gain a number of charges by being placed and then just spawn a fire/water ball each drop until the charges run out.  

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMjI4bXlxZjNzNmFob2FtenF3OWJ2ajNweW43cTFxbW5tYmxteTN3NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/P0kE2WU713GZLvLMcl/giphy.gif[/img]

Then there are spawners like Lake that will consume your ball and spawn a water ball in it’s place. So it’s sort of a trade, that depending on your other triggers and your strategy, can work out really well for you. 

If you’re not using Spawners you’re not playing Ballionaire (well you are but you’re just making it harder for yourself).

notes.title: Let's Go for a Ride
notes.content:
Ballionaire isn’t all about falling with style, sometimes you can hitch a ride of one of the many awesome vehicles in the showroom (I mean game but that sounded cooler so go with it, yeah?). 

Vehicles give you different benefits and bonuses depending on how they synergize with other triggers, kinda like everything else, but these you can ride.  

You can grab yourself a Broom, spooky season all seasons amirite? This, once bonked, allows you to earn 2x but you do fly off the furthest edge of the screen. It looks cool, very cool, but you need to think about where you want to place this to maximise pre-flight bonking. 

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMDBwdWhyc2hkNnU0Z2N2MmttaTBxYTg1bXhkYXVyaHpjOWwyajY3bSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/tPBwbSZP7sfA1se3UO/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOXB4OHh2MW5sbGlpNjZ0d2J6ZmFmNzZpajJsa3FwNThtNjExNjhkdCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/wVGrBlyIfOrSukuqEE/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Keep Calm and Carry On
notes.content:
You’ve probably noticed by now there are a lot of different types of triggers that have a variety of effects when you bonk them.  

Carryables are another type that you need to think about in terms of your strategy. You can collect an unlimited amount of things to carry in Ballionaire which not only looks really cool, but it can really help you hit that Tribute! 
 
We already talked about food items in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2667120/view/4694530240549247573?l=english]previous blog[/url] but you can do so much more than make a tasty snack!  

Carrying a Sword makes you even more imposing and badass when it comes to dealing with Attackables as you’ll inflict 3 extra damage when you’re armed. That could make all the difference between success and well…not success. 

Then there’s also Parachute, I like this one because when I’ve not planned my bottom row very well grabbing a chute will reverse gravity and keeps that ball in play a while longer. A good emergency measure you might say. Although it’s worth noting that if you’re riding a vehicle you’ll abandon it and keep the Parachute instead, and it has a cooldown of 30 seconds (so plan better than I do!) 

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeGVsYzU1aGNqcWg5NDhvb3dld2g1cmtpemFyNjFhNmd6YmJ4N2pkdSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Ron76NMYtFPDCDCwRB/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: You’ve Gotta Hold on to What We Got
notes.content:
Keeping your ball in play as long as possible is one of the best ways to make some serious money in Ballioniare. 

There are a number of ways to benefit from keeping your balls front and center and one of these is by utilising Holders. These come in all shapes and sizes and have different benefits. 

You might have come across some in the demo. 

But let me tell you about a couple just so I can say I did. 

There’s Piggybonk which will hold onto any coin ball it’s bonked by. Each coin ball it holds earns you a nice $800 per ball. Not something to turn your nose up at! 

Another goodie is Whale, this holds any type of ball it’s bonked by, but it grows larger with every ball it contains. Eventually what went in has to come out, and Whale will eject all the balls it holds, and you’ll then earn $800 for each ball. Just remember there’s a cooldown with Whale of 2 seconds, so keep that in mind when you’re placing your holders. 

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcnk2d3RuNnE4eDZjb2Q3MXVzbTgybTdxaG4wNXJhZHk2YnI5aDg5OSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JlUsCCOy0heKYVcFM6/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you know about Holders why not add some into your strategy and become a *turns and finger-guns at camera* BALLIONAIRE!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667120/Ballionaire/

notes.title: Battleionaire
notes.content:
Have you ever wanted to be a hero? A knight in shining armour? Well, we can make that dream a reality…well kinda. 

Meet the [b]Attackables[/b]. 

These are triggers that you can attack, I know kind of self-explanatory I’m just doing my job. There are a number of these in Ballionaire that you bonk to damage, and once you’ve twarted the creature you’ll be rewarded like the hero you are! 

See for example Bombgoblin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/8469cd68159ab1fbe5db0fd28771f67d1bfddb39.png[/img]

An overly smug looking character that has a HP of 15, a cooldown of 30 seconds and once defeated it becomes a spawner! Upon smiting the Bombgoblin you’ll be rewarded with a random mix of 4 fire balls and rock balls that shoot off in all directions. 

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMGFtODhiZHQ4bGJkM25rNWx2cjZrbHdsOGlobmJoZ2NjejRjb2EwaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/fqcr0KDoRksGS2BCkZ/giphy.gif[/img]

So depending where you placed this beastie you can get some extra kerching when you finally take it out! 

Also, and this is important, weapons can really cut down the time it takes to defeat an Attackable so grab a sword and get to work. 

This pachinko roguelike has layers!  

Ballionaire is coming soon to a Steam Store near you, Wishlist NOW!

notes.title: BALLS!
notes.content:
Now you might have guessed from the name of the game but there’s balls in Ballionaire, I know groundbreaking. 

What you might not have realised is just how many different types of balls you might come across in your pursuit of Ballionaire status. 

There’s your standard ball that you use to obtain as much money as you can, there’s coin balls, fire balls, rock balls, water balls and believe it or not, even more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/5cd4b64f697209e43b6fcd635dc1207377874914.png[/img]

These different types of balls work in different ways and are an important consideration in your synergy strategy, trigger placement and boon selection. Who knew there was so much to think about when it came to balls?! 

I’m not going to tell you too much, but let’s take fire balls as an example. 

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcjAwZGlnaHZ1ZHFzZ3llcm55ZmY3OXJkNHVzc250Z3gxdnI0ZDZ0eiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/LX3KW3wbT5KhFNlTPO/giphy.gif[/img]

Fire balls can be spawned from Camp Fire and used to light Candle which, whilst lit, will give adjacent triggers a x2.0 multiplier, not bad at all. 

You can also bonk Torch to carry it and turn your existing ball into a great ball of fire!

When you start to understand how these balls can benefit you and how they synergize you’ll be one step closer to being a Ballionaire*

notes.title: Respect Your Elders
notes.content:
If you played the demo you’ll be familiar with these 3. If not, or you just clicked start and didn’t pay attention (I see you!) let me explain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/42437d890a77261a288ebdc2140e7dc029a46f17.jpg[/img]

When you start on the road to become a Ballionaire you need to appease 3 Elders by reaching a monetary target (known as a Tribute) that they have set for you. They also can provide you with a lovely little Tribulation to make things a smidge more interesting. 

The first elder is the Keeper, you’ll need to satisfy Tributes I, II and III ranging from $500 to $5,000 in a limited number of drops to pass the test.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/05c7c32e1fa97f5c0f7bb553e92962c58d647037.png[/img]

Only by fulfilling these Tributes can you move on to The Adept 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/c2c17294c93e9e0204abc7a4a922ee143d562cc5.png[/img]

And The Hierarch 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/890e4ed40ad9e7a37fb379a924c1f80443e941d6.png[/img]

Obviously, each Tribute gets more challenging as you progress, so you’ll need to be smart about your trigger placement, your synergy and of course those pesky tribulations the elders inflicted upon you. 

Don’t worry you got this…I think.

notes.title: Ballionaire's Bouncy Triggers!
notes.content:
Welcome back, Ballionaires! 

I want to introduce you to a few triggers that will help your ball(s) get around the board which, I suppose, is the whole point. How else are you going to make the big bucks and achieve your tributes? The Elders must be satisfied if you hope to ascend the order of Ballionaires.

Balls in Ballionaire don’t simply drop from top to bottom, where’s the [strike]money[/strike] fun in that? No, they can go on quite a journey indeed! 

Let’s meet two of the very bouncy triggers — First up is [b]Mushroom! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/f6fa91022bfab22c0270d76e7e93079aa76e9f46.gif[/img]

Mushroom works hard to help keep your balls in play. When a ball bonks Mushroom, it bounces back up the screen quite a bit! Your balls will go a lot further thanks to Mushroom!

Next we have [b]Jumprope[/b].

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbGpqZ3pybXM3ajJsdXJlMXRub3NrM3d4ZnQzZms2NmNmejExOGJxdyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hOYbsOy9XHtvu0nEmd/giphy.gif[/img]

Jumprope doesn’t have much oomph, but it keeps the ball nicely in place! Maybe Jumprope is good if you want to repeatedly bonk a trigger? Jumping rope is healthy, not just for a Ballionaire’s fitness, but also for your wallet!

I hope you enjoyed this first peek into Ballionaire! Stay tuned, there are lots more triggers to talk about! And boons! And tribulations!

Stay tuned for more updates! In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam and join the Discord at https://discord.gg/kC7YuBDyfj

notes.title: Ballionaire's Art Inspiration
notes.content:
Welcome, Aspirant Ballionaires! 

Whether you're new to the game, or you're a long-timer and have played the prototype on itch (maybe even played it a lot?) - welcome to Ballionaire, now on Steam! 

I’m Brian, aka newobject, the creator of Ballionaire. I’ve been working feverishly on the game for almost a year now, and I’m so excited to start to reveal it today! Ballionaire is a roguelike “numbers go up” pachinko-builder. An “autobonker”, as I like to call it! It combines chaotic, kinetic motion with a simple-but-deep drafting-and-theorycrafting strategic level of play.

For this inaugural post, I wanted to discuss the game’s visuals. If you’ve played the prototype, I’m happy to report they’ve undergone a serious glow-up - here’s a little peek at the new direction: 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2667120/announcements/detail/4597700312709961170]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/f7b68c9d4d612441ee800dc994938450b522dd99.png[/img][/url]

Ballionaire takes its visual inspiration from many sources: the world of indie comics and underground zines, media with iconic character identities like Mr. Men and Adventure Time, as well as classic games like Parappa the Rapper and Katamari Damacy. In fact, if you want a peek into the strangeness of my brain while making Ballionaire, you can even check out the [url=https://www.canva.com/design/DAF1ZIStuTY/j66Hl6xPyMNU6cfRsw2Cqw/edit]mood board[/url] I’ve used to keep on theme!

The world of Ballionaire is populated by everyday objects, come to life - what we call “triggers” in the game. Let’s meet one of them right now, Brick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/5ffff691406c91e3b8f46cdb126771c6ceb807e4.gif[/img]

Brick will happily spawn a new Coin ball if you’re able to bonk him from below. He’s pretty beat up and chipped, but putting on a brave face - smiling and doing his job. Turns out, it’s a lot of work, being a trigger. But if you want to be a Ballionaire, you’ll need their ceaseless labor to earn you big bucks. Not that you get to keep this money - no no no, it’s merely a tribute you’ll pay to the Ballionaire Elders … an obscure order of wealth hoarders who we’ll meet in a future Steam post. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667120/Ballionaire/


Ballionaire’s mood takes inspiration from things like Spirited Away, Pikuniku, The Prisoner, and Undertale. But don’t think about it too much. Just put a smile on your face and start bonking - the Elders await your tribute. Welcome to Ballionaire!

Stay tuned for more updates! In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam and join the Discord!
